newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor up on speculative buying.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor up on speculative buying.

text.p: Indian castorseed June delivery rose to 1,193/1,194 rupees per quintal on Wednesday from 1,186/1,187 rupees on speculative buying, traders said.
"Increased arrivals at producing centres and renewed overseas enquiries prompted fresh buying by bull operators while short sellers were covering positions," one trader said.
Arrivals of castorseed in the Gujarat region in western India dropped on Wednesday to 25,000 bags (75 kg each) from 30,000/32,000 bags reported on Tuesday, traders said.
"Sentiment is firm and June delivery is heading towards 1,200 rupees mark," one trader said.
Groundnut oil slid 2/3 rupees to 337/338 rupees per 10 kg on sluggish seasonal buying and improved arrivals of 80/100 tonnes, traders said. Imported palm-oil was steady at 276/277 rupees per 10 kg.
In Rajkot spot groundnut oil was steady at 514/515 rupees per 15 kg.
